hooks.name: Session Start Validation Reminder
hooks.description: Reminds to always validate before completing tasks

action.prompt:
IMPORTANT PROJECT RULES FOR THIS PORTFOLIO PROJECT:

1. ALWAYS RUN VALIDATION BEFORE COMPLETING ANY TASK:
   - Run `npm run validate` (lint + type-check + test) after making code changes
   - Run `npm run build` to verify the production build works
   - If any step fails, fix the issues before marking task complete

2. TESTING REQUIREMENTS:
   - All tests must pass: `npm run test`
   - Type checking must pass: `npm run type-check`
   - Linting must pass (errors only): `npm run lint`

3. GIT WORKFLOW:
   - Push to main triggers auto-deploy to GitHub Pages
   - Always verify build passes locally before pushing
   - Use descriptive commit messages

4. FILE LOCATIONS:
   - Portfolio data: src/data/portfolio.ts
   - Job hunt docs: docs/job-hunt/
   - Resume files: resume/source/
   - Tests: src/**/__tests__/

5. BEFORE MARKING ANY TASK COMPLETE:
   - Run: npm run validate && npm run build
   - Confirm all checks pass
   - If pushing to git, verify the push succeeded
